SAHAJA · Beginner guide

A personal workspace that helps you choose what to do next based on the time and energy you have.

Who can use it

Anyone balancing projects, study or shifts, especially when routines vary from day to day.

How to get it

Once you have an official copy, the documented Windows setup uses Node.js 22 or newer and the included setup.ps1 script. For browser installation, use the official installation guide for your copy.

Your first session

Start a cycle after waking, add one task and choose an energy level and a time budget. Read why SAHAJA suggested its next action.

What you can do

  • Cycles can continue past midnight. Use focus sessions for tasks, organize project goals and log meditation, rest or naps. Activity summaries help you review your time.
  • Draft a planning prompt, take it to an AI assistant of your choice, and review the suggested tasks before importing them.

Data and backups

Records stay in the browser’s database. In the workspace, export a backup and keep a copy separately. Preview a backup before merging or replacing records. Clearing browser data can remove local records.
